userPromptSubmitted.bash: cat >/dev/null; [ -n "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" ] || exit 0; [ "$(ps -o pgid= -p $PPID | tr -d " ")" = "$(ps -o tpgid= -p $PPID | tr -d " ")" ] || exit 0; printf '\033]7501;state=working:app=copilot\033\\' >/dev/tty 2>/dev/null; exit 0

notification.bash: in=$(cat); [ -n "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" ] || exit 0; [ "$(ps -o pgid= -p $PPID | tr -d " ")" = "$(ps -o tpgid= -p $PPID | tr -d " ")" ] || exit 0; case "$in" in *permission_prompt*) k=permission;; *elicitation_dialog*) k=question;; *) exit 0;; esac; printf '\033]7501;state=blocked:kind=%s:app=copilot\033\\' "$k" >/dev/tty 2>/dev/null; exit 0
